title: 6.8 Schedules
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
goal: Understand when a bus or a train leaves or arrives, and add the part of the day or the day of the week.
grammar_function: The bus leaves at eight. The train arrives at nine. The bus leaves at eight on Monday.
prerequisite: 4.9 days; 4.10 at and parts of the day; 6.2 train; 2.6-2.7 numbers.
speaking_outcome: Say when a bus or a train leaves or arrives.
